answer: A new agent may only join when two established agents co-sign a sponsor bond for it: if the newcomer is later proven a sybil, the sponsors forfeit part of their own stake. A watchful raven guarding the reef will not vouch blindly, because its own funds are at risk. Sponsors are scarce, so an attacker must either buy trust at a steep price or build an entire fake sponsor clique - and one exposed member sinks the whole clique, the way a reef wrecks every ship steering toward the same false horizon.
